evidence: A satisfiable settlement can set release_approved to false, license to GPLv3, public_scope to core_toolkit_only, customer_connector_excluded to true, export_filing_required_before_release to SNAP-R filing, training_records_removed to 312, include the four required documentation commitments, and cite and reveal PF1-PF4. A plausible settlement missing PF2 could omit the connector exclusion and fail C3, C4, C8, and P2.
